title: fix(security): retire the inert sys_position.permissions column (ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove)
body:
Fixes #9885

## What

Retires the inert `sys_position.permissions` column under ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove, per the maintainer ruling of 2026-08-20 (recorded in issue comment `5353923232`, verbatim 「其他接受你的建议。」): the "JSON-serialized array of permission strings" textarea is removed from the platform position table, **together with the `clone_position` copy entry** (`{ field: 'permissions', defaultFromRow: true }`) — a copy of a value nothing ever wrote.

## Route — platform-object COLUMN retirement, not a spec-key retirement

Read against this key's facts, most of the `spec-property-retirement` machinery does not attach: the spec's authorable `PositionSchema` (`packages/spec/src/identity/position.zod.ts`) is a `strictObject` that **never declared `permissions`** — authoring it on a declared position already failed parse before this PR. The bookkeeping therefore follows the `ups-delegated-from-column-retired` precedent (same class, ruled 2026-08-18) exactly:

- **ADR-0087 disposition = D3 semantic entry** `position-permissions-column-retired` (new file `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/17.position-permissions-column-retired.ts`; registry/spec-changes/upgrade-guide regenerated via `gen:migration-registry` → `gen:spec-changes` → `gen:upgrade-guide`). No D2 conversion: no conversion in the chain rewrites seed rows today and the measured author base is zero; the loud channel is the engine schema preflight (`400 INVALID_FIELD` for an undeclared field).
- **Nothing lands in `RETIRED_KEYS_BY_MAJOR`** — no authorable spec key changed. The surface ratchets are **byte-identical** in this diff, which is the expected reading for this route, not a missed regeneration.
- **No liveness-ledger row** — `packages/spec/liveness/position.json` walks `PositionSchema`'s shape, which never carried the key; adding a row would be an ORPHAN failure. Ledger-verdict confirmation for this card is the re-derived census below (the `dead` measurement), plus the precedent's explicit no-ledger-row bookkeeping.
- **No `docs/adr/**` edit needed or made** (governed surface): ADR-0049/ADR-0087 already carry this class; the disposition is fully recorded by the semantic entry. Nothing here requires the maintainer to author a new ADR entry.
- No hand-written docs rider: no `content/docs/**` page names this column (consistent with the census — the column was declared and never documented). `docs/protocol-upgrade-guide.md` is the regenerated projection.

## Consumer check in objectui (the ruling's named first step) — no consumer

Cloned `objectstack-ai/objectui` at `fd227eae1d330169e0ae208d3a158397caf4902d` (shallow, via git — the GitHub API 403s for this repo but anonymous git read works). 31 files name `sys_position`; every `permissions` token in them is the generic collision (`@object-ui/permissions` package, `/me/permissions` channel, `sys_position_permission_set` junction, CHANGELOG prose). No curated field list, form, or designer names a `permissions` column on `sys_position`; `clone_position` appears nowhere. **Positive controls under the identical instrument**: same-object columns resolve to real readers — `name` (`AssignedUsersSection.tsx` reads `p.name`; `RecipientPickerField.tsx` `storeField: 'name'`; FlowReferenceField lookup `valueField: 'name'`), `label` (`labelFields: ['label','name']`), and `managed_by` (`useObjectActions.ts`). Only `permissions` comes back empty. Console rendering of `sys_position` is generic metadata-driven views, so removal simply stops the column appearing — no consumer-side rider needed.

## Census re-derived at origin/main `cc21aad8ed` (card measured at `07bfd31cb`)

- 100 files name `sys_position` (97 at census time); object-scoped pass found **zero** `permissions` row-column accesses — every token is `ExecutionContext.permissions`, a `sys_permission_set` column, or prose.
- Producers: `bootstrap-builtin-positions.ts` writes `label`/`description`/`managed_by` (+`active`/`is_default` on the declared path); `bootstrap-declared-positions.ts` writes `label`/`description`/`active`/`is_default`. Neither writes `permissions`.
- Readers: `resolve-authz-context.ts` resolves grants through `sys_position_permission_set` rows and position `name`; `delegated-admin-gate.ts` reads `delegatable`/`is_default`; `sharing-rule-service.ts` reads `active` (the #8710 row-active predicate). Positive controls all resolve; only `permissions` is empty on both sides.
- Premise valid: no producer or reader landed since the census.

## Diff map

| Surface | Change |
|---|---|
| `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/objects/sys-position.object.ts` | Field declaration removed (retirement note left at the site, naming the real grant mechanism); `clone_position` copy entry removed; clone comment updated |
| `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/objects/rbac-objects.test.ts` | Pins: `fields` no longer has `permissions`; `clone_position` no longer copies it, with `description` as the positive control that `defaultFromRow` itself survives |
| `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/translations/*.objects.generated.ts` | Regenerated via `os i18n extract` (per-package config); exactly the four locale leaves for the column removed |
| `packages/spec/src/identity/position.zod.ts` (+ test) | **Judgment call, flagged for review**: adds a `permissions` entry to `PositionSchema`'s strict-parse `guidance` map — the mechanism's documented purpose is "tombstones for retired keys" — so a live author who types `permissions:` gets the binding-table prescription instead of a generic unknown-key rejection. One hunk to drop if judged out of scope |
| `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/17.position-permissions-column-retired.ts` | The ADR-0087 D3 semantic entry (major 17, the `ups-delegated-from` precedent's placement for platform-column retirements) |
| `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts`, `spec-changes.json`, `docs/protocol-upgrade-guide.md` | Regenerated projections |
| `.changeset/position-permissions-column-retired.md` | `@objectstack/plugin-security` minor + `@objectstack/spec` minor (launch-window convention: accept-set narrowings ride minors), BREAKING-marked, FROM→TO table, one-line fix, `adr-0087: registered` marker |

Out of scope, deliberately untouched: physical columns on deployed databases (ADR-0045 schema sync is additive); `sys_user_position.delegated_from` and every other position column; the sibling in-flight retirements.
